nodes.label: LiveKit + Claude DIY Provider Research
nodes.rationale: the backend builds the session and the worker stays prompt-agnostic so a prompt edit ships with the web app (as with OpenAI) and the worker never needs to import apps/web or hold a Supabase key; phased by technical risk (text -> laptop voice -> phone -> measure) over spend-staged/risk-category/parallel-seam framings because the cheapest, riskiest checks should fail fast before costly setup like a phone build or a load test.
